Shared/TieDefinition.luau.description: Constructs a new interface declaration which allows for interface usage between both Roblox API users and OOP users, as well as without accessing a Also allows for extensibility via implementing interfaces. Public entry points include `update`.

Shared/TieImplementation.luau.description: This class represents the implementation for a given definition. For the lifetime of the class, this implementation will be exposed to consumption by both someone using the tie interface, and anyone invoking its methods via the normal Roblox API.

Shared/TieInterface.luau.description: Tie interfaces can be retrieved from an implementation and allow access to a specific call into the interface.

Shared/Utils/TieUtils.luau.description: Tie Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Tie package. Public entry points include `TieUtils.encode`, `TieUtils.encodeCallback`, `TieUtils.invokeEncodedBindableFunction`, `TieUtils.decode`.
